support.duration_definition: Sum of adjacent valid sample intervals; gaps are excluded

observability.interpretation: Local motion/Schur/box/convergence diagnostics; no calibrated uncertainty or uniqueness guarantee

config.motion_prior_units: Sum per trajectory of integral squared world acceleration dt; lambda not secretly normalized by image or point count

derivatives.ground_truth_derivative: Continuous analytic material motion, symmetric difference at 0.1ms
